blindSourceSummaries: NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (status 401, paywall); the underlying wire report (25 Aug 2022) covers police denying violence in the death of a trans activist from a neighbouring country, a university affiliate, in a tourist-island region following an arrest on drug charges.

A university daily feature (September 2022): the mother of a 32-year-old trans rights organiser says he was beaten and extorted for a sum equivalent to many years of local wages after arrest on drug charges at a national airport; he died three days later in a local hospital while in police custody; police deny violence.

An international-affairs magazine (August 2026): vigilante mobs attacked trans women across the country in a 14-16 July 2026 wave, including over 15 trans women doused, stripped and beaten in a major city with footage shared online; an October 2025 presidential decree lists 'the promotion of LGBTQ+ culture' among nonmilitary threats alongside terrorism, radicalism and drug addiction; legal gender change requires sex reassignment surgery plus judicial approval; some local administrations apply moral bylaws with corporal punishment; a researcher documents markedly hardened anti-queer attitudes since 2016.
